about.name: Suresh Koragana
about.summary: Data Engineer specializing in building and optimizing scalable PySpark-based data pipelines. Experienced in improving data quality, resolving complex data inconsistencies, and delivering reliable data solutions across AWS and Azure environments. Strong focus on performance, scalability, and enabling data-driven decision making.

education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

details: Built and fine-tuned large-scale Spark pipelines handling high-volume datasets, significantly improving processing efficiency and enabling faster data availability for downstream analytics.
Modernized legacy SQL-based workflows by transitioning them to distributed PySpark architectures, resulting in improved scalability and reduced execution time.
Developed a flexible data quality and anomaly detection system that minimized manual validation and strengthened trust in analytics outputs.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams to convert business requirements into scalable data models and production-ready ETL workflows.
Created resilient ingestion and transformation pipelines capable of handling diverse datasets at scale, supporting critical analytics use cases.
Applied fuzzy matching techniques using RapidFuzz to address inconsistencies in complex datasets, improving entity mapping accuracy and uncovering valuable business relationships.
Re-architected existing SQL and Pandas workflows into Spark-based pipelines, achieving substantial improvements in processing performance.
Designed ingestion frameworks to transform raw data into structured and query-optimized datasets for downstream consumption.
Took ownership of complete pipeline workflows, from ingestion through validation and delivery, reducing reliance on manual processes.
Automated scheduling and orchestration of ETL pipelines using Autosys, improving operational efficiency and SLA compliance.

projects.name: Cloud-Native Real-Time Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.description: Designed and developed a scalable real-time data pipeline leveraging Kafka, PySpark, and AWS to process high-frequency stock market data streams.
highlights: Implemented event-driven data ingestion using Kafka to capture and process streaming data in near real-time.
Built a fault-tolerant data pipeline with checkpointing and partitioning strategies to ensure reliability and scalability.
Architected the system to support both real-time and batch processing patterns, aligning with modern Lakehouse design principles.
